name: kanban_update
description: Change a card's title, notes, assignee, priority, deadline, column, goal link, or labels. Assigning, moving, or setting a deadline is announced in the board's chatroom; editing text is not.
llm_description: Update a card's title, body, who/assignee (empty to unassign), priority (low/normal/high), deadline (unix seconds, 0 = none), column, goal link, or labels. Assigning, moving, or deadline changes are announced in the board room; text edits are not.

who.description: Instance name to assign to, or empty to unassign

assignee.description: Alias of who; instance name to assign to, or empty to unassign

column.description: Move the card to this column as part of the update (backlog, ready, doing, review, done, archive)

goal.description: Goal id (state/goals.json) to link this card to, or empty to unlink

labels.description: Replacement label set for the card

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
